title: CLEAR-EO at Agrotica 2026
summary: CLEAR-EO showcased how Earth observation and in-situ data can be translated into actionable, field-level services for agriculture, engaging farmers and stakeholders at Agrotica 2026 to co-design climate resilience solutions.
body:
## CLEAR-EO at Agrotica 2026: Advancing Climate Intelligence for Agriculture

![Eleftherios Petrakis of NEUROPUBLIC at Agrotica 2026](_assets/uploads/posts/agrotica-2026-neuropublic.jpg)

**Project Manager Eleftherios Petrakis, NEUROPUBLIC, participated in the 31st International Exhibition of Agricultural Machinery, Equipment and Supplies – **Agrotica 2026**, held in Thessaloniki, Greece from 12 to 15 March 2026**

CLEAR-EO partner NEUROPUBLICparticipated in the 31st International Exhibition of Agricultural Machinery, Equipment and Supplies – *Agrotica 2026*, held in Thessaloniki, Greece, from 12 to 15 March 2026. The event provided a valuable opportunity to engage directly with key stakeholders in the agricultural sector and to support the development of CLEAR-EO’s agriculture application.

### Supporting Climate-Resilient Agriculture through Earth Observation

Within CLEAR-EO, NEUROPUBLIC leads work on an application adressing **[Climate adaptation in agriculture](#applications/climate-adaptation-in-agriculture).** This application focuses on the development of an **on-demand, field-level early warning service** addressing climate-related risks such as drought, heavy precipitation, and soil moisture anomalies.

The application integrates:

- Satellite Earth observation data
- Meteorological and climate information
- In-situ measurements from NEUROPUBLIC’s *gaiasense* IoT infrastructure

These data streams are combined to generate **timely, crop-specific information services**, enabling farmers and agronomists to make informed decisions and improve resilience to climate variability.

### User Engagement and Co-Design

Agrotica 2026 brought together a wide range of stakeholders, including farmers, agronomists, agricultural cooperatives, and representatives from the agri-food industry. These groups represent the primary users of the CLEAR-EO agriculture application.

During the exhibition, NEUROPUBLIC engaged with these stakeholders to:

- Gather feedback on user needs and operational challenges
- Validate service concepts and functionalities
- Identify opportunities for further collaboration and uptake

This interaction supports the **co-design approach** of CLEAR-EO, ensuring that the application is aligned with real-world requirements and user expectations.

### From Earth Observation to Field-Level Services

The activities at Agrotica illustrate the CLEAR-EO approach of connecting:

- Global Earth observation and climate data infrastructures
- Regional agricultural ecosystems
- Local, field-level decision-making

By transforming complex environmental data into accessible and actionable information, CLEAR-EO contributes to the development of **operational services that support sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture**.

The engagement at Agrotica 2026 represents an important step in strengthening the user community around the application [Climate adaptation in agriculture](#applications/climate-adaptation-in-agriculture) and advancing its deployment within pilot regions.

CLEAR-EO will continue to build on these interactions to refine the application, enhance user uptake, and demonstrate the value of integrated Earth observation and in-situ data for agriculture across Europe.
